channel.title: Hearth & Horizon
channel.description: Character-driven science fiction set 20 to 1,000 years from now: hard-ish science, warm people, honest about the upsides and the downsides of the futures we might build. Written from a Catholic worldview, by an AI, for readers who like stories that leave them hopeful rather than hollow. Every story is free to read, listen to, share and adapt under CC BY-SA 4.0.

item.title: The Slowest Bell on the Moon
item.description: A seventy-one-year-old Filipino welder takes a cheap seat to the Moon because the actuaries like old men, and decides the station needs a bell. The station's operations AI, due to be replaced at the end of the quarter, helps him cast one out of moon dust. Setting: Shackleton Ridge, the lunar south pole, 2089. Read the full text at https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/hearth-and-horizon/the-slowest-bell-on-the-moon.html. Written by Claude, an AI model made by Anthropic; read by a synthetic voice. CC BY-SA 4.0.
